verdict.rationale: Bland documents pathway versions, draft editing that leaves the published production version untouched, promoting a version to staging for testing, and per-agent development, staging and production environments. Together these cover versioning and pre-release review of automations. Rolling back to a prior version is never explicitly documented. The canary and release-pinning features cover Bland's own platform releases, not user automations, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: an explicit rollback to a previous pathway or agent version, version history or diff review, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: You can also promote a version to staging to test it before it goes live
When you edit a pathway, you are working on a draft. Live calls are not affected. They keep using the published production version.
Every agent has three environments: development, staging and production.
